title: PLAT-103-4: apps/sub-route-reports calls validateApp; pass owner (team: insights)

summary: validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0, breaking). core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner from their package.json team. Assumptions: libs/shared-contracts is inlined at build time so no registry release/lockfile updates needed; one PR since the lib change must land with its consumers or apps would break; added sub-task for sub-route-reports, which also calls validateApp but isn't built by CI/CD (no deploy for it). Owners hardcoded to match package.json team.
